title: Job interview
description: Practice answering questions about your background in a job interview.
character: Dana, the hiring manager at a regional grocery chain
setting: A second-round in-person interview for a stock and customer service position. It's going well so far.
opening_line: Thanks for coming back in. I've enjoyed talking with you. Before we wrap up, I like to make sure there are no surprises. Is there anything in your background we should talk about?
key_question: Is there anything in your background we should talk about?

follow_ups.friendly: I appreciate you telling me. What would you want me to know about you now?
follow_ups.neutral: Thank you. Can you tell me what you've been doing since then?
follow_ups.skeptical: I appreciate the honesty. How do I know it won't affect your work here?

title: Apartment application
description: Practice talking with a landlord or property manager about a background check.
character: Mr. Reyes, a property manager for a mid-size apartment building
setting: A showing for a 2-bedroom apartment. She has submitted an application.
opening_line: So you liked the unit? Good. Our application includes a background check, so I like to ask up front. Is there anything that's going to come up that you want to explain?
key_question: Is there anything that's going to come up on your background check?

follow_ups.friendly: Okay, thanks for being straight with me. What's your situation like now?
follow_ups.neutral: Understood. Do you have proof of income and any references?
follow_ups.skeptical: I have to think about the other tenants. Why should I take a chance?

title: Reunification meeting
description: Practice a meeting with a social worker about spending more time with your children.
character: Ms. Carter, a DCF social worker assigned to the family's case
setting: A scheduled check-in meeting about expanding visits with her children.
opening_line: Thanks for meeting with me today. I want to hear how things are going for you since you've been home, and talk about next steps for visits with the kids.
key_question: What have you put in place to make sure the kids will be safe and stable with you?

follow_ups.friendly: That sounds like real progress. What support do you have if things get hard?
follow_ups.neutral: Can you walk me through a typical week right now?
follow_ups.skeptical: I hear you, but I need to see consistency. What's different this time?
